items.title: Cigna allegedly ran the clock on a teen's mental health claims - Insurance Business
items.reason: This reports an alleged claim-denial/delay practice by Cigna (a major payer) involving mental health claims, which falls directly under payer litigation and enforcement related to claims-denial suits.
items.summary: Cigna is facing allegations that it deliberately delayed processing a teenager's mental health insurance claims, effectively running out the clock on coverage. The article describes a claims-handling practice by the payer that resulted in claim denials or processing delays for mental health services. This type of allegation—involving improper claims handling and potential denials by a major insurer—directly impacts revenue-cycle operations by highlighting payer enforcement exposure, claims-processing disputes, and potential regulatory scrutiny of Cigna's claim adjudication practices that revenue-cycle teams must monitor for industry-wide patterns.
